description: Places opponent respawn points (model opponentRespawn) on a regular grid, one every intervalX by intervalY cells, skipping forest cells (and optionally house footprints). Note: this generator's Clear is not implemented. It shares the opponentRespawn model with HiddenRespawnGenerator.

intervalX.description: Horizontal spacing in cells between respawns.

intervalY.description: Vertical spacing in cells between respawns.

skipHouse.description: If true, do not place respawns on cells covered by a House object.
